headline: US pushes Ukraine-Russia trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi; Rubio signals ICC confrontation and Venezuela democratic transition timeline
facts: US National Security Advisor Jared Kushner and Steve Bannon held trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi on November 9, 2026 (Secretary Rubio, Paris press conference)
National security advisors from Germany, UK, and France were present in Abu Dhabi, involved in prior Shell Bay meetings in Florida (Rubio)
Ukraine war enters sixth year in February 2027; Rubio stated conflict resolution requires negotiated agreement (Rubio)
Gang Suppression Force in Haiti currently at 2,000 personnel with 3,000-4,000 additional pledged; Kenyan-led effort being replaced (Rubio)
Venezuela democratic transition on pace for new supreme court magistrates by mid-December 2026; electoral council to follow 'very quickly thereafter' (Rubio)
7 million Venezuelans abroad; no open US consulates in United States for Venezuelan voting (Rubio)
Brazilian government has not granted agrément for US Ambassador nominee Danny Perez (Rubio)
Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) attributed to refrigeration/cyber attacks on France; France announced this November 9, 2026 (Rubio, French Foreign Minister)
Iran's military degraded: 'no navy, no air force' compared to one year prior; retains some capabilities (Rubio)
US-Israel 10-year Military Financing agreement expires; President directs shift to Foreign Military Sales model potentially beginning 2027 (Rubio)
ICC claims jurisdiction over non-member states; US has attempted year-and-a-half reform effort rejected by ICC (Rubio)
watchlist: Abu Dhabi trilateral talks productivity; risk of diplomatic stalemate if Russia maintains maximalist demands
ICC confrontation escalation; potential US sanctions against International Criminal Court triggering allied division
Venezuela electoral timeline adherence; democratic transition fragility if PSUV delays magistrate appointments
Brazil-US ambassador impasse; signals larger regional friction on trade and diplomatic protocol
Iran IRGC asymmetric cyber/kinetic campaign expansion; potential for regional escalation beyond current theatre

headline: 미국, 인도태평양 3국(싱가포르·인도네시아·일본) 경제·기술 협력 강화 방문
facts: Jacob S. Helberg 국무부 경제담당 차관이 2026년 10월 28일~11월 7일 싱가포르, 인도네시아, 일본 방문 (출처: U.S. Department of State)
인도네시아에서 에너지 및 정보통신기술 분야 20억 달러 이상 규모의 미국 상용 거래 협의 진행 (출처: 동일)
싱가포르에서 미국 AI 기술 확대 및 보안 강화 관련 신규 계약 체결 (출처: 동일)
일본에서 반도체, 첨단 광물, 에너지, 로봇, 해저 케이블 등 분야 산업 리더와 협의 (출처: 동일)
watchlist: 중국의 인도태평양 영향력 확대에 대한 미국의 대항 전략 심화 가능성

headline: 미국-독일, G7 파리 회담에서 해양 자유항행·국방산업 협력·무역 강화 논의

headline: 미국, 파라과이 신임 대통령 알리아나와 양자 관계 강화 재확인
facts: 마르코 루비오 미국 국무장관이 2026년 11월 8일(또는 9일 이전) 파라과이 페드로 알리아나 대통령과 통화 (U.S. Department of State 발표, 2026-11-09)
